rationale: Read the canonical conjecture and full specification. Uniform labelled simple cubic graph counting uses finite cardinalities over the actual graph type, including disconnected graphs. The even-size sequence enumerates all n>=4, and its denominator is positive. It neither changes to multigraphs nor counts graph isomorphism classes.

The actual Real.Angle torus, one contribution per unordered edge, non-strict IsLocalMin and synchronization across all vertices exactly retain the original event. Target is the literal limit-one conjecture. The limit-zero and quantitative answers are separately named propositions, not substitutes or proofs of Target.

The concrete gradient and Hessian sums have the correct edge factors and act on real mean-zero directions. Strict cosine >1/32 is explicitly the archived stronger answer; Hessian >=1/320 and local-minimum/non-synchronization clauses are simultaneous. Fixed-radius/fixed-cycle limits and supporting constants are recorded without adding rate claims to Target. Final implementation must inspect the actual graph/Angle/topology APIs and check all three named statements.
